raised: The fees are just as confusing in both versions
In version 2 the S&P and MSCI rows are taller because the grey tags wrap onto a second line
The note under the heading makes the reader wonder which funds are missing and whether a cheaper one is among them
"(4A)" and "(4D)" in the fund names mean nothing to the reader
Not sure what "צוברת" means and wants it confirmed
Doesn't understand "עסקת החלף" (swap) and worries it's riskier
"מס גם על שינויי המטבע" is unclear: how much does it actually cost?
The page doesn't say what "מאיה" is
Unclear whether the underlined fee numbers can be clicked or have an explanation behind them
Unclear whether the fixed, variable and trustee fees add up, and what makes the variable fee change
Missing: one total yearly cost per fund, ideally in shekels
Missing: how each fund has performed over recent years
Missing: how big each fund is
Missing: a plain explanation of holding the shares vs a swap in terms of risk
Would remove the security number column first

problems.why: The reader praises the explanation under the index name rather than calling it unnecessary, and never says the index column is wider than its content. The only row-height complaint is about the grey tags wrapping, not the index text.
